FX-PAINTBUCKET-001.says: The settings as they start: the point in the middle on the skin, Color & Alpha, tolerance 10, Antialias, red, opacity 100, normal: the skin inside the line, columns 3 to 9 and rows 2 to 7, turns red, its edge softened a pixel into the line and the shadow.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-002.says: Tolerance 25: the shadow, 54 levels from the skin at most, matches too, so the whole inside of the line turns red.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-003.says: The point on the line, Color & Alpha: the line's box turns red; its half-covered left edge differs by half in alpha and stays.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-004.says: The same point, Straight Color: the soft edge has the line's own colour, so it is filled too, red only as far as it shows.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-005.says: Transparency with the point in the empty corner: the empty border all round the cel turns red and opaque.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-006.says: Transparency with the point on the skin: the point must be in a clear place, so nothing is filled: the cel as it was.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-007.says: Opacity with the point on the skin: every opaque pixel joined to it, line, skin and shadow, turns red; the soft edge stays.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-008.says: Alpha Channel with the point on the skin: every pixel as opaque as the skin, the same as FX-PAINTBUCKET-007 here.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-009.says: Invert Fill: everything but the skin turns red, the empty border included.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-010.says: View Threshold: the skin white, everything else black, all opaque.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-011.says: View Threshold at tolerance 25: skin and shadow white.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-012.says: Feather, softness 2: the red skin's edge fades over a few pixels.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-013.says: Spread, radius 1: the red reaches a pixel further, over the line and into the shadow, then is softened.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-014.says: Choke, radius 1: the red pulls a pixel in from the line and the shadow.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-015.says: Stroke, width 1: only the skin's outer ring of pixels turns red.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-016.says: Spread radius 0: nothing added, FX-PAINTBUCKET-001's frame.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-017.says: Fill Only: the red fill alone, the rest of the layer clear.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-018.says: Blue, multiply: the skin darkened toward blue.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-019.says: Blue, screen: the skin lightened toward blue.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-020.says: Opacity 50: half way from the skin to red.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-021.says: Opacity 0: the cel exactly as it was.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-022.says: The point keyed from (25, 50) at frame 0 to (75, 50) at frame 4: the skin at frames 0 and 2, the shadow at frame 4.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-023.says: Tolerance keyed from 10 to 30: skin only at frames 0 and 2 (20), skin and shadow at frame 4.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-024.says: Opacity keyed from 40 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 by an ease that passes its end: held at 100 at frame 2, FX-PAINTBUCKET-001's frame.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-025.says: FX-PAINTBUCKET-001 moved three pixels right: the layer's own pixels move, the three columns it left are empty.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-026.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the point is the drawing's own, and the skin is closed in by its line, so the frame is FX-PAINTBUCKET-001's.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-027.says: The point past the layer's left edge, (-50, 50), with Invert Fill: no pixel matches, so the whole layer turns red and opaque.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-028.says: Straight Color on the line with Fill Only: the fill alone, the soft edge at half covering.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-029.says: Choke, radius 2: only the skin's middle, columns 5 to 7 and rows 4 and 5, is filled, then softened.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-030.says: Blue, add: the skin lifted by blue, held at 1.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-031.says: Transparency in the empty corner at tolerance 60: the soft edge, half covered, matches too.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-032.says: Fill Point across 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-033.says: Tolerance -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-034.says: Tolerance 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-036.says: Stroke Width -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-037.says: Feather Softness 10001, above 10000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PAINTBUCKET-038.says: Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
